name: Invokely
description: Hosted MCP and REST API for official statistics by indicator, place, and period, with a source citation on each figure. The Free plan includes 500 MCP calls/month with no card; REST data queries require Builder, Pro, or prepaid credits, while the separate no-account MCP trial allows 25 calls/day per IP. Endpoint: `https://invokely.ai/mcp` · Trial endpoint: `https://invokely.ai/mcp/trial`
